original_requirement: Replace the invalid cross-era PTR3 source comparison with fresh current successor evidence while preserving historical evidence, proving sealed lineage, revalidating PTR3 semantics, and keeping all execution and production behavior disabled.
closed_world_justification: The Short materializer has one PTR3 readiness helper, one immutable historical successor artifact, one fresh current successor profile, three named parent baselines, and an exact finite set of source/fingerprint/semantic bindings. Unknown schemas, profiles, paths, ancestry, and identities fail closed.
operational_definition: Historical R1-PTR3 evidence is validated as immutable ancestor evidence; R1PTR3CurrentRuntimeSuccessorV1 separately binds the current sealed lineage, production bytes, execution identities, compatibility baselines, and an exact semantic revalidation receipt. The materializer requires both eras and never equates their source snapshots.
forbidden_narrowing: No mismatch whitelist or ignored hash
No modification or reinterpretation of historical PTR3 evidence
No stale, unknown, unrelated, or partially validated successor
No production source, BAML, Prompt, Model, Route, Retry/Fallback, Budget, Validator, Canon, StoryState, READY, Draft, Final Review, or Maintenance runtime change
No credential, Provider client, network, model, paid call, Fresh packet, cohort, approval, or Canary execution

constraint_traceability.requirement: Historical PTR3 evidence remains immutable and exact
constraint_traceability.implementation: historical_ptr3_evidence_v1 validates fixed artifact SHA, Git blob, report tree, schema, implementation head, final report and test receipt
constraint_traceability.evidence: Historical SHA bcba49fe..., blob 7683bc..., and report tree f2c9f4... remain exact. No historical path is changed.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Fresh current successor binds current bytes and authorized lineage
constraint_traceability.evidence: Valid current successor passes; stale source, HEAD, ancestry, schema/profile, fingerprints, semantic and parent evidence fail closed.

constraint_traceability.requirement: PTR3 semantics are revalidated rather than inferred from hashes
constraint_traceability.implementation: sc-succ1-semantic-revalidation-v1.json is hash-bound by the successor
constraint_traceability.evidence: Exact finding propagation, replacement, stale-count zero, bounds, escaping, validator, merge and unchanged topology tests pass.

constraint_traceability.implementation: Current successor binds their sealed manifests and explicit compatibility records
constraint_traceability.evidence: Guard negative capability, alternate/fail-close behavior and import isolation remain unchanged and passing.

constraint_traceability.requirement: No external action or production behavior change
constraint_traceability.implementation: Canary-only pure file/Git/hash validation under FailClosedNetworkSentinel
constraint_traceability.evidence: All external counters are zero and git diff for src and baml_src is empty.

projected_failure_mechanisms: a later authorized runtime change makes a current successor stale
a successor seal commit includes an unrelated path
a parent artifact or manifest is modified
a source file differs from the current successor receipt
a plan uses a different Build/Config/Runtime/Prompt/route/model identity
semantic revalidation receipt is missing or altered
a new successor schema or profile appears without explicit support
line endings differ between Git blob and working-tree evidence
model_output_not_applicable_evidence: Only Canary evidence-binding code, Canary tests, maintenance documentation, and SC-SUCC1 reports change. No production Provider adapter, parser, prompt, contract, validator, route, retry/fallback, budget, or model-output behavior changes.
unknown_variant_behavior: Unknown current successor schemas/profiles and unknown committed or dirty paths fail closed.
why_previous_tests_missed: The original readiness fixture was correct at the R1-PTR3 era, but its helper treated historical current_protected_sources as permanently current. Later authorized PTR9 source changes were sealed and validated, while no test modeled historical ancestor identity separately from a fresh current-runtime successor.

sibling_boundaries.evidence: Fixed SHA/blob/tree and original schema/gate are checked without writing the artifact.

sibling_boundaries.boundary: Fresh Short PTR3 and R1-D3 readiness builders
sibling_boundaries.evidence: Both builders require the fresh current successor; materializer regression passes in temporary isolated output.
Guard regression and compatibility bindings pass; no guard source changes.
Import isolation tests pass and no SC-IC1 implementation file changes.

remaining_risks: The SC-SUCC1 paths remain unsealed until a separate evidence-only seal task commits them.
Any later production or identity change requires a new current successor rather than editing this one.
A Fresh Short packet still requires separate materialization and single-use final user authorization.
